question: Indian-origin South African, Geeta Ramji, who passed away in March 2020, is known internationally for her contribution in which field?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Virology.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• **Indian-origin South African, Geeta Ramji, who passed away in March 2020, is known internationally for her contribution in Virology.**
 
• Gita Ramjee was a Ugandan-South African scientist and researcher in HIV prevention.
 
• In 2018, she was awarded the **‘Outstanding Female Scientist’ **award from the European and Developing Countries Clinical Trials Partnership.
 
• She died in Umhlanga, Durban, South Africa, from COVID-19 related complications.
